subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

If I hand her a flower and say, “Give it to mamma,” she __take it __to her mother.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is written in the** present tense**, as indicated by the phrase “If I hand her a flower and say...”
 
• The verb should be in the **present tense** to match the rest of the sentence.
 
• The correct present tense form of the verb is **"takes"** to ensure subject-verb agreement with the singular subject "she".
 
• Other options are incorrect:
 
 
• **“Was taking it” **uses the **past continuous tense**, which does not match the present tense context of the sentence.
 
• **“Had took it”** and **“Had taken it” **use the **past perfect tense**, which is also not consistent with the** present tense **context of the sentence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is "*If I hand her a flower and say, “Give it to mamma,” she takes it to her mother."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When expressing actions that are happening in the present or are regular occurrences, the** present simple tense **is used.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *If he calls me, I **answer** the phone.*
 
• *When she feels hungry, she **eats** an apple.*
